title: Paper Trail
description: Morrow's automated debt system has been charging a neighborhood twice. Correct the ledger and its backup mirror so the change survives the next sync.
objective: Correct Research vault AND Backup mirror.
condition: Below 60% trace: +100 cr / +20 XP. Each optional archive: +100 cr / +15 XP; all three pay XP.
aftermath: Thousands of duplicate balances disappear. Morrow replaces a maintenance identity; its perimeter gets a little stronger.

lore.title: Rounding errors
lore.text: MORROW / INCIDENT 441: Duplicate balances correlate exactly with the migration date. Customer support has filed nineteen matching reports. The classification remains 'individual payment dispute'.

lore.title: The second signature
lore.text: Ledger maintenance memo: Both primary and mirror require correction. An automated reconciliation job restores whichever record carries the older authorization stamp. A single correction will disappear overnight.

lore.title: A letter never sent
lore.text: Unsent message from a collections clerk: I can see the charge twice. I can see the payment once. The script tells me to say the account is accurate. I am keeping copies of everything.
